rows.title: New book on Ray Dalio sheds light on CT funding saga
rows.standfirst: Hedge fund founder Ray Dalio has said he’s working on his legacy. Given revelations in the new book ‘The Fund,’ what might that be?

rows.title: CT businesses will dodge federal unemployment tax hike next year
rows.standfirst: CT averted the increase by paying $1.2 billion borrowed from Washington during the first two years of the pandemic for jobless benefits.

rows.title: Is CT’s budget boom over? Report likely to show eroding revenue
rows.standfirst: A new report is expected to show CT’s budget remains in balance — but that the days of huge surpluses are over for now.

rows.title: CT higher education faces big cuts as pandemic funds disappear
rows.standfirst: Money that kept CT higher education afloat during the worst of the coronavirus pandemic is going away, and colleges face course and job cuts.

rows.title: Connecticut’s revenues are down but budget still balanced, report projects
rows.standfirst: A new report projects CT’s revenue will drop $460 million over the next two years, but budget surpluses are still expected.

rows.title: How CT’s regional colleges want to mitigate $140M budget shortfall
rows.standfirst: The proposal from CT State Colleges & Universities leadership involves cuts to security, travel costs and other efficiencies, but no layoffs.

rows.title: Why Lamont can’t fully make his case on CT higher education cuts
rows.standfirst: Ned Lamont could project how higher education expenses might clash with CT’s spending cap. But legally, the administration isn’t allowed.

rows.title: Even as surpluses shrink, CT could see balanced budgets for years
rows.standfirst: Even if the economy slips, CT could have a rainy day fund approaching $4 billion, its largest fiscal bulwark ever, by next fall.

rows.title: Applications for heating assistance are already up nearly 25%
rows.standfirst: Will CT’s heating aid program run dry before winter is over? CT legislative leaders say they may need a January session to meet the demand.
